entries.3afb913529ff39dd: The company is a manufacturer headquartered in Inagi, Tokyo. Together with 17 consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate, it operates the Industrial Functional Filter and Conveyor Business, the Electronic Materials and Photomask Business, the Environmental and Water Treatment Business and the Real Estate Leasing Business. As of November 30, 2025, the number of employees was 1,273. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.

entries.47e6333a5797ab19: Industrial Functional Filter and Conveyor Business
entries.511253ed1b46026d: A manufacturer headquartered in Inagi, Tokyo, that manufactures and sells papermaking fabrics, industrial wire mesh, photomasks and other products.
entries.6a8499d22db41c38: This business manufactures and sells etched products made from metal materials and composite film materials, and photomasks used in the manufacture of semiconductors, displays, printed circuit boards, MEMS and other products. The company is responsible for manufacturing and sales, and the equity-method affiliate Dehui Keji Co., Ltd. (Taiwan) also manufactures and sells electronic components. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥4,556 million.
entries.821b93edbebca565: Manufacturers of Semiconductors, Displays and Other Products
entries.b5583d54d87abfa3: This business manufactures and sells wire mesh for paper and pulp making and various specialty industrial meshes for screening, filtration and conveying. Papermaking wire mesh is manufactured by the company, FILCON FABRICS & TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD. in Thailand, Saito Tokushu Kanaami Co., Ltd. and others, and various specialty industrial meshes are manufactured by Kansai Kanaami Co., Ltd. and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥20,030 million.
entries.c4b409744fc0957d: This business designs and sells pool bodies, water treatment equipment and other environment-related products. It is carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Aqua Product Co., Ltd., which also sells insulating joints that prevent corrosion and gas leaks in natural gas pipelines. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥2,223 million.
entries.e73a687ab0caf320: Factories in Various Industries Such as Nonwoven Fabrics and Food
entries.fb070cef821097d9: This business leases real estate owned by the company as stores, condominiums, parking lots and other facilities. Using former factory and company housing sites, among others, its rental properties are operating steadily. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥1,031 million.
